id.description: Permanent slug. NEVER changed after first publication — it is the public URL. Use developer + project (+ phase), e.g. 'ellington-business-bay-offices'.

aliases.description: Former or alternative slugs for the same project (renames, misspellings). Used for deduplication — a new record whose id matches an existing record's alias is rejected.

project.description: Project name, or a working name with '(working name)' suffix when the developer has not announced one.

developer.description: Developer name as publicly known. Use 'To be confirmed' when genuinely unknown.

developerId.description: graf.ae developer hub id (e.g. 'ellington', 'aldar') — only when certain; enables the 'New from {developer}' hub block.

location.description: District / area as sourced. Distinguish broker phrasing from formal address.

status.description: confirmed = developer announced/launched officially. broker-intelligence = multiple broker sources, no official confirmation — page renders with explicit caution wording. rumour = single/weak source — NO page is generated until upgraded.

launchWindow.description: Free text as sourced ('September 2026', 'H2 2026', 'Coming soon'). Omit rather than guess.

startingPrice.description: AED. Set ONLY with priceConfirmed; otherwise null and put the circulating figure in brokerPriceNote.

priceConfirmed.description: true only when the developer's own price list confirms startingPrice. Unconfirmed prices never render as facts.

brokerPriceNote.description: Circulating price info with attribution, e.g. 'brokers quote ~AED 2,500/sqft; unconfirmed'. Rendered with a broker-indication label.

pricePerSqft.description: AED/sqft — same confirmation rule: without priceConfirmed it is treated as broker indication.

paymentPlan.description: e.g. '70/30'. One canonical spelling — 80/20 and 20/60/20 describing the same schedule must not both appear.

teaser.description: One card sentence. Factual, no hype.

summary.description: 2-4 sentences for the mini page lead. Only sourced facts; unknowns stated as unknown. If omitted, the site composes a template lead from the fields.

whatNext.description: One sentence: what confirmation is awaited.

confidenceNote.description: Free-text caveat rendered on the page, e.g. 'Name is broker-invented; Ellington has not confirmed.'

primary.description: The page's 'View announcement source' link. Exactly one per record. Prefer a dated, non-developer public page.

updatedAt.description: Bump ONLY on a substantive change (new fact), not on every touch — it renders as 'Updated' and feeds dateModified.

published.description: false = record kept in the feed but no page generated (draft / withdrawn).
